request.prompt:
Create a dedicated MYTHIC boss animation source sheet for exactly the supplied character, preserving its unique costume/materials/anatomy. One slender gold-hilted silver SWORD in anatomical RIGHT hand, LEFT gauntlet empty. Preserve tiara, black braid, lace collar and violet ribbons; no Iris winged helmet or red hair.
Fixed camera throughout this sheet: NORTH straight BACK facing UP away from viewer. Show back of head/torso. Anatomical RIGHT weapon hand is viewerRIGHT; LEFT empty hand viewerLEFT.
Action RUN: Six clear locomotion poses in order: phase0 RIGHT leg contact, phase1 RIGHT leg compresses/LEFT free leg swings, phase2 RIGHT toeoff/LEFT knee drives, phase3 LEFT leg contact/RIGHT leg lifts, phase4 LEFT leg compresses/RIGHT free leg swings, phase5 LEFT toeoff/RIGHT knee drives. CORRECTION: The FIRST reference establishes identity ONLY and may face the wrong side. The SECOND reference establishes a reviewed same-character camera direction. Adopt the required camera below consistently for ALL SIX poses; never copy the first reference camera automatically.
Exactly ONE anatomical RIGHT-held weapon throughout if the character uses one; never hand swap or duplicate. Left hand stays free. Natural head recoil is fine without changing the overall facing.
Layout EXACTLY SIX COMPLETE distinct animation poses in TWO COLUMNS and THREE ROWS (2x3), read row-major 0,1 / 2,3 / 4,5, WIDE LANDSCAPE transparent canvas. Keep each figure body about200px high with identical scale. Each full silhouette including extended wings, scythe, axe, staff, sword, tail and cape must fit comfortably inside its own large cell with generous empty alpha gutters and outside margins. No pose or weapon intersects another; no anatomy reaches canvas edge. No floor/shadow/effects/text. Preserve character identity and action sequence. Not flipped, no mirrored anatomy.
